title: Vapouriz 50/50 Ice N Fruit 10ml
description: Ice 'N' Fruit delivers a fresh blend of mixed berries finished with a cool Menthol breeze. Juicy red and dark berries lead the flavour, offering sweet and tangy notes, while the menthol element adds a crisp, frosty layer that leaves a refreshing aftertaste. This 50VG/50PG e-liquid is tailored for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping and pairs best with pod systems, refillable vape pens and starter kits. It delivers a balanced throat hit with clear flavour and subtle vapour output. Blended in the UK by Vapouriz Labs, the Vapouriz 50/50 range is made for consistency and quality, offering a wide range of satisfying flavours for use with lower-powered vape devices. Thanks to its 50/50 ratio of VG and PG, this e-liquid provides a smooth, flavour-rich vape that’s well-suited to everyday use in refillable kits and crossover devices.
